sents.zh: 一千六百多年以前，有一个很有名的诗人。
sents.en: More than sixteen hundred years ago there was a famous poet.

sents.zh: 他年轻的时候也做过官。
sents.en: When he was young he had served as an official.

sents.zh: 做官可以有钱，也可以有名。
sents.en: An official could have money, and could have a name.

sents.zh: 可是他一点也不喜欢那样的日子。
sents.en: But he did not like that kind of life at all.

sents.zh: 他觉得每天都要说不想说的话。
sents.en: He felt he had to say things every day that he did not want to say.

sents.zh: 所以有一天，他决定不做了。
sents.en: So one day he decided to stop.

sents.zh: 他回到自己的家，开始种田。
sents.en: He went back to his own home and began to farm.

sents.zh: 他种稻子，也种菜，还种了很多花。
sents.en: He grew rice and vegetables, and many flowers as well.

sents.zh: 早上他去田里工作，晚上他写诗。
sents.en: In the morning he worked in the fields; in the evening he wrote poems.

sents.zh: 他写的诗不长，可是很美。
sents.en: His poems were not long, but beautiful.

sents.zh: 他在诗里说，在田里的时候，他的心很自由。
sents.en: In them he said that in the fields his heart was free.

sents.zh: 虽然他家里不富，但是他过得很快乐。
sents.en: Although his family was not rich, he lived happily.

sents.zh: 有人问他：“你后来觉得这样好吗？”
sents.en: Someone asked him: "Did you feel it had been the right thing?"

sents.zh: 他说：“我要的不多，这样就好。”
sents.en: He said: "I do not want much; this is enough."

sents.zh: 一千多年过去了，中国人还在读他的诗。
sents.en: More than a thousand years have passed, and Chinese people still read his poems.
